clause: Performance metrics with a finite AUC
detail: Structured AUROC. This is the denominator of the liability count.

clause: AUROC metrics that mention the liability scale
detail: Free-text match for 'liability' in Other Metric(s) or the performance note. Subclasses are the next two rows.

clause: AUROC metrics with nested or incremental liability R2
detail: The string also says nested or incremental, so the value is not a marginal liability-scale R2.

clause: AUROC metrics that name liability R2 without a further definition
detail: Named liability R2 with no nested model and no stated prevalence.

clause: AUROC metrics reporting Nagelkerke pseudo-R2
detail: Nagelkerke pseudo-R2 is not a liability-scale R2.

clause: AUROC metrics reporting another pseudo-R2
detail: Covariate-adjusted or other pseudo-R2, not labelled liability-scale.

clause: AUROC metrics reporting an unspecified R2
detail: The string says R2 or variance explained and does not name the scale.

clause: AUROC metrics reporting no R2
detail: No R2 in the other-metric field or the performance note.

clause: AUROC metrics whose other metric is not an R2
detail: Another metric is present (for example AUPRC) and it is not an R2.

clause: Figure 1C performance metrics
detail: Distinct PPM identifiers in 13_cell_identifiers_long.csv.

clause: Figure 1C metrics that mention the liability scale
detail: None of the Figure 1C metrics names the liability scale.

clause: Figure 1C metrics reporting an unspecified R2
detail: Bare R2 string; scale not stated.

clause: Figure 1C metrics reporting Nagelkerke pseudo-R2
detail: Info field identifies Nagelkerke's method.

clause: Figure 1C metrics reporting no R2
detail: Empty R2 fields.

clause: Performance metrics in the release that mention liability anywhere
detail: Includes records whose AUC sits only in free text, so they sit outside the finite-AUROC count.

clause: Performance metrics that state an author-assumed prevalence
detail: The prevalence is an author assumption written into the metric string, not a Catalog field. See 17_liability_r2_examples.csv.

clause: Evaluation sample-set rows in the release file
detail: bulk_evaluation_sample_sets_20260923.csv. One sample set can occupy more than one row.

clause: Distinct evaluation sample-set identifiers
detail: Unique PGS Sample Set (PSS) identifiers in that file.

clause: Sample-set rows with case and control counts
detail: These rows support an evaluation case fraction P = cases / (cases + controls). P is not the population prevalence K.

clause: Distinct sample-set identifiers with more than one case/control pair
detail: The same PSS identifier is stored with different numeric case and control counts, so P is not a single Catalog value. In Figure 1C: PSS011515.

clause: Figure 1C sample sets with more than one case/control pair
detail: Figure 1C uses 13_cell_identifiers_long.csv. 1 of its sample sets have more than one case/control pair in the release file.

clause: Sample-set columns that record population prevalence
detail: No sample-set column matches prevalence or liability.

clause: Figure 1C cells with a paired OR or HR
detail: An odds ratio or hazard ratio still needs K, and per-SD scaling is not a structured field. See 12_or_per_sd_summary.csv.

clause: Liability-scale R2 implied by AUC 0.60 at three prevalences
detail: Wray et al. 2010 population-sample mapping. K = 0.01 -> R2 = 0.018; K = 0.10 -> R2 = 0.033; K = 0.50 -> R2 = 0.049. Lee et al. 2012 changes these values again when the sample is ascertained. See 17_liability_r2_prevalence_sensitivity.csv.
